markdown.markdown:
::: {.callout-note} Welcome, students! This academic portal provides unit-specific study materials, syllabus outlines, and exam revision resources to help you master P4 and prepare for your modular exams. ::: ## 1. Syllabus The detailed syllabus structure for Edexcel Pure Mathematics 4 (P4) comprises the following topics:
### 1. Proof 1.1 Proof by contradiction.
### 2. Algebra and functions 2.1 Partial fractions.
### 3. Coordinate geometry in the (x, y) plane 3.1 Parametric equations.
### 4. Binomial expansion 4.1 Binomial series for rational powers.
### 5. Differentiation 5.1 Implicit and parametric differentiation.
5.2 Simple differential equations.
### 6. Integration 6.1 Volume of revolution.
6.2 Integration by substitution and parts.
6.3 Integration using partial fractions.
6.4 Solving first order differential equations.
6.5 Area under parametric curves.
### 7. Vectors 7.1 2D and 3D vectors.
7.2 Magnitude of a vector.
7.3 Vector algebra.
7.4 Position vectors.
7.5 Distance between two points.
7.6 Vector equations of lines.
7.7 Scalar product and angles between lines.
